constraints.name: input_graph_directed_tree
constraints.description: The input graph for each test case is a directed tree, i.e., if all edges were undirected, the graph would be a tree.

constraints.name: operation_maintains_directed_tree
constraints.description: After each operation (removing an existing edge and adding a new edge), the resulting graph must still be a directed tree.
constraints.formal: For any operation transforming G to G', G' must be a directed tree.

constraints.name: target_rooted_directed_tree
constraints.description: The graph after all chosen operations must be a rooted directed tree, i.e., there exists a vertex r from which all vertices are reachable along directed edges.
constraints.formal: ∃ r ∈ V: ∀ v ∈ V, there is a directed path from r to v.
